title: HUMAN-GCP-WEB-OAUTH-CLIENTS-001 Standby Handoff Update

context.decision_d15: Google OIDC disabled; password-first is default. OIDC is optional provider, required only when explicitly enabled.
context.prior_next_field: 2026-08-30 產品決策已改為「帳密為預設、OIDC 可選」。此 human OAuth task 暫不再是 dev/staging/prod 部署前置；待 ODP-WEB-OIDC-OPTIONAL-DEPLOYMENT-001 合併並由 ODP-WEB-PASSWORD-FIRST-SECURITY-E2E-001 驗證後，改為僅在啟用 Google OIDC 時才需執行。不得在新機制完成前將其標記完成或略過 provider 驗證。

updated_next_recommendation: Prerequisite implementation tasks (ODP-WEB-OIDC-OPTIONAL-DEPLOYMENT-001 PR #1074, ODP-WEB-PASSWORD-FIRST-SECURITY-E2E-002 PR #1096) are merged into dev. Static code inspection confirms that password-first / OIDC-off resolver precedence and fail-closed callback routes are intact. Historical E2E suite passed at merge commit 2377168c (receipt date 2026-09-01). Live deployment readback and OAuth provider readiness remain unknown without live environment probing. This Human OAuth task transitions from 'deployment blocker' to 'standby for explicit OIDC enablement'. Execute only when the business decides to enable Google OIDC login.

handoff_and_entry_conditions.wp90_canonical_writer_handoff: Upon A-stage review approval, WP-90 / canonical writer updates HUMAN-GCP-WEB-OAUTH-CLIENTS-001 standby instructions on the orchestrator board.
oauth_enablement_entry_conditions: 1. Product Authority issues explicit business decision to enable Google OIDC login.
2. Human/Ops executes HUMAN-GCP-WEB-OAUTH-CLIENTS-001 to create GCP OAuth 2.0 Web Client credentials and store secrets in Secret Manager.
3. Release / Ops Engineer deploys with explicit ODP_AUTH_MODE=oidc, performs live environment readback, and conducts live OAuth provider validation.
